title: Sar Buland Khan Is Released and Sirhind Comes Into View

blocks.text: This hinge page first lets Sar Buland Khan plead for subordinate status and mercy rather than continued imprisonment. Charat Singh answers from a position of sovereign confidence, stressing that even Ahmad Shah's uncle had been taken and that Sikh power now speaks in its own right rather than as a client of older courts.

After that display of superiority, clemency follows. Provisions are given for the journey, safe onward movement is allowed, and the released noble becomes a witness to Charat Singh's prestige rather than a martyr to it.
The page then pivots decisively toward Sirhind. A new military problem emerges, and the poem begins gathering the forces, routes, and intentions that will culminate in the next major Sikh strike.
